verdicts.title: On automorphism groups of affine surfaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This is a survey on the automorphism groups in various classes of affine algebraic surfaces and the algebraic group actions on such surfaces. Being infinite-dimensional, these automorphism groups share some important features of algebraic groups. At the same time, they can be studied from the viewpoint of the combinatorial group theory, so we put a special accent on group-theoretical aspects (ind-groups, amalgams, etc.). We provide different approaches to classification, prove certain new result
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract describes a survey on automorphism groups of affine algebraic surfaces from algebraic and combinatorial group theory viewpoints (ind-groups, amalgams), with no mention of CNF formulas, Boolean circuits, or monotone width. It shares the 'automorphism groups of affine' vocabulary but does not interact with the specific complexity-theoretic claim.

verdicts.title: Automorphism Groups of Configuration Spaces and Discriminant Varieties
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The configuration space $\mathcal{C}^n(X)$ of an algebraic curve $X$ is the algebraic variety consisting of all $n$-point subsets $Q\subset X$. We describe the automorphisms of $\mathcal{C}^n(\mathbb{C})$, deduce that the (infinite dimensional) group Aut$\,\mathcal{C}^n(\mathbb{C})$ is solvable, and obtain an analog of the Mostow decomposition in this group.
